{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print the correlation value with sufficient precision to allow rounding to 3 decimals
print(f'{correlation:.10f}')"}
